curator_note: Gabber, hardtek and freeform hardcore from the Clubfreakz crew, venue still secret. Fine if you want a sweaty late-night rave, but it sits well outside the house and techno groove.
description: Location-TBA hard-dance night from Clubfreakz covering gabber, hardtek and hardcore, starting at 10pm.

artist_notes.name: DLR
artist_notes.note: Drum & bass producer; the night is billed under the Momentive label banner.

curator_note: A proper drum & bass bill with MC Gusto on the mic and a long 10pm-to-4:30am run. It's a different groove from house, but it's a real DTLA warehouse-style night if you're in the mood for jungle energy.
description: Late-night drum & bass party in a TBA DTLA venue with DLR and MC Gusto, 10pm to 4:30am.

curator_note: Your walkable Saturday-morning staple, so there's nothing to plan. Go early for produce before the crowds, and it's an easy pairing with a coffee on Sunset.
description: Weekly neighborhood farmers market on Sunset Blvd in Silver Lake, Saturday mornings until 1:30pm (also Tuesdays).

curator_note: Local-leaning house bill at Dada, close to home and an early-ish 8pm to midnight, so it won't eat your whole night. I don't know these three well enough to oversell it; check Posh for sound clips first.
description: Other/Aura presents a house night at Dada in Echo Park with Warner Case, Nico Besso and Lowr.

curator_note: Free, and an acid, italo and house mix at a DTLA bar is a good low-stakes Sunday-ish detour. It's a bar-scale night put on by Midnight Lovers, so go for the vibe rather than a big name.
description: Free night at Bar Franca in DTLA with Demi Riquisimo playing acid, italo disco and house, 7pm to 2am.

artist_notes.name: Snakehips
artist_notes.note: UK duo behind funky, R&B-flavoured dance-pop and house (the 'Cruel' / 'All My Friends' era).

curator_note: Glossy, R&B-tinged funky house from the UK duo, more big-room fun than deep-cut digging. Academy is a loud Hollywood room, so expect a pop-leaning crowd.
description: Snakehips DJ set at Academy Nightclub in Hollywood, 10pm to 3am.

artist_notes.name: Greg 99
artist_notes.note: Brazilian producer from Minas Gerais making Latin and Afro-inflected tech house; Beatport #1 collab with Cloonee.

curator_note: Greg 99 is a rising Latin tech-house name with a Cloonee link, so this is a danceable, percussive night rather than a chin-stroker. Sound is a solid room for it.
description: Afro and Latin house night at Sound Nightclub in Hollywood with Greg 99 and Pedroz, 10pm to 2:30am.
